parts.text: Nitric acid, HNO 3 , and sulfuric acid, H 2 SO 4 , are strong acids. Ethanoic acid, CH 3 COOH, is a weak acid.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) One mole of each acid is added separately to 1000 cm 3 of distilled water to form a dilute solution. All three acids dissociate in distilled water.

parts.label: vi
parts.text: (vi) Name the two gaseous products formed during the electrolysis of dilute sulfuric acid using inert electrodes. ............................................................... and ............................................................... [2]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Aluminium nitrate, Al (NO 3 ) 3 , is made when dilute nitric acid reacts with aluminium hydroxide, Al (OH) 3 .

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) The oxidation number of the O atoms in Al (NO 3 ) 3 is –2. The formula of the aluminium ion in Al (NO 3 ) 3 is Al 3+ . Determine the oxidation number of the N atoms in Al (NO 3 ) 3 . Show your working. oxidation number of N = .............................. [2]
